tasks.label: build-debug-binary
tasks.command: GIT_DESCRIBE=$(git describe --tags --always) && TAG=$(echo "$GIT_DESCRIBE" | cut -d'-' -f1) && COMMIT=$(echo "$GIT_DESCRIBE" | cut -d'-' -f3) && go build -gcflags="all=-N -l" -ldflags "-X main.Tag=${TAG} -X main.Commit=${COMMIT}" -o "${workspaceFolder}/farm-debug" cmd/main.go
